name: WebsitePusher
author: WebsitePusher
description: Push your local WordPress changes to your live site safely. Automatic backups before every update, instant undo, and plain English controls built for non developers.
changelog: * A full-site pull now brings the images and media down on hosts that keep the uploads folder on separate storage (a link from wp-content/uploads). Before, those sites' images were left out without a warning.
